title: Diffraction grating; Wave–particle duality
source: Questions copied unchanged from the mission-lesson scripts for Edexcel A-level Physics (status of the source: mission-lesson scripts of Oct-Nov 2026 (reviewed by AI reviewers; not signed off by a person)). Terms and clues: Q03-1#t2 term and clue written for the game; W09-1#t2 term and clue written for the game; Q03-1#t4 term and clue written for the game; W09-1#t3 term and clue written for the game. Questions: Q03-1#N.4a, W09-1#N.4a, Q03-1#N.17b, W09-1#N.8a, W09-1#N.10.

assemble.prompt: Match each term to its definition.

items.label: de Broglie wavelength
items.clue: The quantity h/p for any moving object; it gets shorter as momentum rises.

items.label: Slit spacing
items.clue: Symbol d: one divided by the number of lines per unit length of the plate.

items.label: Electron gun
items.clue: Hot filament plus an accelerating potential of a few kV, producing the beam.

items.label: Zero order
items.clue: Straight-through beam, white for white light because every λ has θ = 0 there.

questions.stem: An electron is accelerated from rest through a potential difference of 2.0 kV. Take h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, e = 1.60 × 10⁻¹⁹ C, m_e = 9.11 × 10⁻³¹ kg and c = 3.00 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, and treat the electron as non-relativistic. What is the de Broglie wavelength of the electron?
Light of wavelength 650 nm is incident normally on a diffraction grating that has 600 lines per millimetre. At what angle to the straight-through direction is the second-order maximum observed?
A beam of electrons and a beam of protons are each accelerated from rest through 100 V and aimed at the same crystal, whose rows of atoms are 2.0 × 10⁻¹⁰ m apart. Which beam shows clear diffraction?

options.text: Only the protons: they are heavier, so they hit the atoms harder and are scattered more.
Both equally: they have the same charge and the same p.d., so they gain the same energy.
Only the electrons: their wavelength is comparable with the spacing of the atoms.
Neither: diffraction is a property of waves, and both beams are made of particles.

questions.stem: Predict first. White light is incident normally on a diffraction grating. Which describes the pattern seen on a screen?

options.text: A white central maximum, with a spectrum in each order on either side and violet nearest the centre
A white central maximum, with a spectrum in each order on either side and red nearest the centre
A spectrum at the centre, as well as in each order on either side, with violet nearest to the centre
A white central maximum and a white maximum in each order, as all colours share the same angles

questions.stem: A laser beam is directed normally at a grating with 500 lines per mm. On a screen 1.00 m from the grating, the two second-order spots are 1.50 m apart. What is the wavelength of the laser light?
